_comment: Scenes: .tscn and .tres are deliberately NOT denied. The sanitise and resources gate stages verify them, so they meet the same bar as everything else the agent owns. Read docs/SCENES.md before writing one.

The gate: check.py, arch.py, sanitise.py, tools/validate_resources.gd and .gate.sha256 are denied because editing the gate is the one route to a false green. The integrity stage catches it even if this deny list is bypassed.
--accept-gate-changes is denied because re-baselining the manifest must be a human decision.
ARCHITECTURE.md is generated: run `python arch.py --write` instead of editing it.
arch.rules.json and gate.rules.json are intentionally NOT denied. The agent may propose rule changes; AGENTS.md requires it to ask before widening a boundary.
project.godot is denied so the [debug] warnings block and [importer_defaults] cannot be quietly altered. Use bootstrap.py --import-profile for import defaults.
